utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the eighteenth of September. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: We can hear you. I'm less functional than the audio, mind. The broken coffee machine in the canteen has finished me off.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That coffee was mostly a threat anyway. You're probably better off.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Between that and the football last night, not a brilliant start. How do you miss from there?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Years of practice, presumably.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get the full match analysis, let's separate the finished stuff from what actually needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We tested the Gas Turbine 1 yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. So that one's a closed item, not another job coming round.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel last night. That's complete as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. We also finished the repair on the Stretch Wrapper last night.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That repair's finished, then? Just keeping the completed entries separate from today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Completed repair, not something we're assigning again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One observation from me: heard a slight rattle from the Line 3 Chiller, nothing to action yet. Just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only, no new job off that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I'm still waiting on parts for the Site Water System, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So still blocked. Nothing executable there today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Same position, not a fresh request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace Liu, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the wrapper this afternoon? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the wrapper this afternoon. Understood on the urgency.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—both bits, yeah? Not just getting the jam out?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Both bits. Clear the jam, then check the sensors. That's what I'm taking on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. That's the urgent one for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, separate from the repair we've just closed. I was about to muddle those entries.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, today's commitment is the jam and the sensor checks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've also got the monthly fire alarm test still needing an owner.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test by the 28th. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie Brennan. By the 28th, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That priority makes sense. Not an emergency doesn't mean it can disappear off the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you do a site visit at the warehouse with the contractor? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The visit with the contractor, yeah? Not taking on any repair work off the back of that in this meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the site visit at the warehouse with the contractor. That's the scope.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, I'll do that. It matters but it's not urgent, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And there's no time or date being agreed for that here, correct?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Don't put a deadline in that we haven't agreed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll grease and check the bearings on the air compressor tomorrow at 9:30. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Tomorrow as in Saturday? Sorry, my brain's still on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Saturday, yeah. Tomorrow at 9:30, grease and check the bearings on the air compressor.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide. Normal priority for that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, not being presented as a breakdown, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, normal priority. That's all I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll schedule downtime for the water booster with production at half two. Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, just so we don't cross wires: at half two you're doing the scheduling with production, not saying the downtime itself starts then?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. At half two I'll schedule it with production. We haven't agreed a downtime window here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Got you. I heard half two and thought it was going off then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, just the scheduling. Low priority, as I said.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one: the sensors on the air dryer need recalibrating today at 2pm. The priority cue is no rush. Anyone able to own that?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't take that one on. Don't put me against it just because it's sensors.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, I can't commit to that either.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So the air dryer recalibration still says today at 2pm, no rush, but there's no owner?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. That's the requirement as raised, but nobody's accepted it. It stays unowned.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: There's also the need to book a contractor to look at the Injection Moulding Line 3 tomorrow morning. Normal priority. That's the booking due tomorrow morning, not a confirmed visit. Anyone taking it?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not me, I'm afraid. I can't commit to that booking.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take that either. My contractor visit at the warehouse is separate; it doesn't cover this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Booking a contractor to look at the Injection Moulding Line 3, tomorrow morning, normal priority—still nobody taking ownership.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, those last two are unowned requirements. Not agreed commitments from anyone, and definitely not completed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Anything else that's just a status update rather than another job?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, that's my lot. And no more football analysis, apparently.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing else. The rattle I mentioned is only an observation, just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same here. Parts are still the blocker on the item I mentioned; no change.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we've got the accepted work and the two unowned items clearly separated. Everyone happy that's what we've actually agreed?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, all clear. Apart from the coffee situation, but that's a personal tragedy, not a job request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Duly sympathised with. Thanks, everyone. We'll leave it there.
